verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ Ἀνένδεκτόν ἐστιν τοῦ τὰ σκάνδαλα μὴ ἐλθεῖν πλὴν οὐαὶ δι’ οὗ ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros tous mathētas autou Anendekton estin tou ta skandala mē elthein plēn ouai di’ hou erchetai
verses.literal: Jesus said to His disciples It is inevitable . . . that stumbling blocks will come but woe to the one through whom they come
verses.literalPt: E DISSE aos discípulos: É impossível que não venham escândalos, mas ai daquele por quem vierem!

verses.original: λυσιτελεῖ αὐτῷ εἰ λίθος μυλικὸς περίκειται περὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔρριπται εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν ἢ ἵνα σκανδαλίσῃ τῶν μικρῶν τούτων ἕνα
verses.transliteration: lysitelei autō ei lithos mylikos perikeitai peri ton trachēlon autou kai erriptai eis tēn thalassan ē hina skandalisē tōn mikrōn toutōn hena
verses.literal: It would be better for him to have a millstone . . . hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble
verses.literalPt: Melhor lhe fora que lhe pusessem ao pescoço uma mó de atafona, e fosse lançado ao mar, do que fazer tropeçar um destes pequenos.

verses.original: Προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς ἐὰν ἁμάρτῃ ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἐπιτίμησον αὐτῷ καὶ ἐὰν μετανοήσῃ ἄφες αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Prosechete heautois ean hamartē ho adelphos sou epitimēson autō kai ean metanoēsē aphes autō
verses.literal: Watch yourselves If your brother sins rebuke him and if he repents forgive him
verses.literalPt: Olhai por vós mesmos. E, se teu irmão pecar contra ti, repreende-o e, se ele se arrepender, perdoa-lhe.

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἑπτάκις τῆς ἡμέρας ἁμαρτήσῃ εἰς σὲ καὶ ἑπτάκις ἐπιστρέψῃ πρὸς σὲ λέγων Μετανοῶ ἀφήσεις αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai ean heptakis tēs hēmeras hamartēsē eis se kai heptakis epistrepsē pros se legōn Metanoō aphēseis autō
verses.literal: Even if he sins against you seven times in a day and seven times returns . . . . . . to say I repent you must forgive him
verses.literalPt: E, se pecar contra ti sete vezes no dia, e sete vezes no dia vier ter contigo, dizendo: Arrependo-me; perdoa-lhe.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἀπόστολοι τῷ Κυρίῳ Πρόσθες ἡμῖν πίστιν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipan hoi apostoloi tō Kyriō Prosthes hēmin pistin
verses.literal: The apostles said to the Lord Increase our faith
verses.literalPt: Disseram então os apóstolos ao Senhor: Acrescenta-nos a fé.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Κύριος Εἰ ἔχετε πίστιν ὡς κόκκον σινάπεως ἐλέγετε ἂν τῇ συκαμίνῳ ταύτῃ Ἐκριζώθητι καὶ φυτεύθητι ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ καὶ ὑπήκουσεν ἂν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Eipen de ho Kyrios Ei echete pistin hōs kokkon sinapeōs elegete an tē sykaminō tautē Ekrizōthēti kai phyteuthēti en tē thalassē kai hypēkousen an hymin
verses.literal: And the Lord answered If you have faith the size of a mustard seed you can say to this mulberry tree Be uprooted and planted in the sea and it will obey you
verses.literalPt: E disse o Senhor: Se tivésseis fé como um grão de mostarda, diríeis a esta amoreira: Desarraiga-te daqui, e planta-te no mar; e ela vos obedeceria.

verses.original: Τίς δὲ ἐξ ὑμῶν δοῦλον ἔχων ἀροτριῶντα ἢ ποιμαίνοντα ὃς εἰσελθόντι ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ Εὐθέως παρελθὼν ἀνάπεσε
verses.transliteration: Tis de ex hymōn doulon echōn arotriōnta ē poimainonta hos eiselthonti ek tou agrou erei autō Eutheōs parelthōn anapese
verses.literal: Which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him Come at once and sit down to eat
verses.literalPt: E qual de vós terá um servo a lavrar ou a apascentar gado, a quem, voltando ele do campo, diga: Chega-te, e assenta-te à mesa?

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐχὶ ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ Ἑτοίμασον τί δειπνήσω καὶ περιζωσάμενος διακόνει μοι ἕως φάγω καὶ πίω καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα φάγεσαι καὶ πίεσαι σύ
verses.transliteration: all’ ouchi erei autō Hetoimason ti deipnēsō kai perizōsamenos diakonei moi heōs phagō kai piō kai meta tauta phagesai kai piesai sy
verses.literal: Instead won’t he tell him Prepare my meal and dress yourself to serve me while I eat and drink and afterward . . . you may eat and drink
verses.literalPt: E não lhe diga antes: Prepara-me a ceia, e cinge-te, e serve-me até que tenha comido e bebido, e depois comerás e beberás tu?

verses.original: μὴ ἔχει χάριν τῷ δούλῳ ὅτι ἐποίησεν τὰ διαταχθέντα
verses.transliteration: mē echei charin tō doulō hoti epoiēsen ta diatachthenta
verses.literal: Does he . . . thank the servant because he did what he was told
verses.literalPt: Porventura dá graças ao tal servo, porque fez o que lhe foi mandado? Creio que não.

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅταν ποιήσητε πάντα τὰ διαταχθέντα ὑμῖν λέγετε ὅτι Δοῦλοι ἀχρεῖοί ἐσμεν ὃ ὠφείλομεν ποιῆσαι πεποιήκαμεν
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hymeis hotan poiēsēte panta ta diatachthenta hymin legete hoti Douloi achreioi esmen ho ōpheilomen poiēsai pepoiēkamen
verses.literal: So you also when you have done everything . . . commanded of you should say We are unworthy servants we have only done our duty . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim também vós, quando fizerdes tudo o que vos for mandado, dizei: Somos servos inúteis, porque fizemos somente o que devíamos fazer.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ αὐτὸς διήρχετο διὰ μέσον Σαμαρείας καὶ Γαλιλαίας
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en tō poreuesthai eis Ierousalēm kai autos diērcheto dia meson Samareias kai Galilaias
verses.literal: While . . . Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem He was passing between Samaria and Galilee
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, indo ele a Jerusalém, passou pelo meio de Samaria e da Galiléia;

verses.original: καὶ εἰσερχομένου αὐτοῦ εἴς τινα κώμην ἀπήντησαν αὐτῷ δέκα λεπροὶ ἄνδρες οἳ ἔστησαν πόρρωθεν
verses.transliteration: kai eiserchomenou autou eis tina kōmēn apēntēsan autō deka leproi andres hoi estēsan porrōthen
verses.literal: As He entered . . . one of the villages He was met by ten lepers . . . They stood at a distance
verses.literalPt: E, entrando numa certa aldeia, saíram-lhe ao encontro dez homens leprosos, os quais pararam de longe;

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἦραν φωνὴν λέγοντες Ἰησοῦ Ἐπιστάτα ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: kai autoi ēran phōnēn legontes Iēsou Epistata eleēson hēmas
verses.literal: and raised their voices shouting Jesus Master have mercy on us
verses.literalPt: E levantaram a voz, dizendo: Jesus, Mestre, tem misericórdia de nós.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδὼν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες ἐπιδείξατε ἑαυτοὺς τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὑπάγειν αὐτοὺς ἐκαθαρίσθησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai idōn eipen autois Poreuthentes epideixate heautous tois hiereusin kai egeneto en tō hypagein autous ekatharisthēsan
verses.literal: When Jesus saw them He said . . . Go show yourselves to the priests And as . . . they were on their way they were cleansed
verses.literalPt: E ele, vendo-os, disse-lhes: Ide, e mostrai-vos aos sacerdotes. E aconteceu que, indo eles, ficaram limpos.

verses.original: Εἷς δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἰδὼν ὅτι ἰάθη ὑπέστρεψεν μετὰ φωνῆς μεγάλης δοξάζων τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Heis de ex autōn idōn hoti iathē hypestrepsen meta phōnēs megalēs doxazōn ton Theon
verses.literal: When one of them saw that he was healed he came back praising God in a loud voice
verses.literalPt: E um deles, vendo que estava são, voltou glorificando a Deus em alta voz;

verses.original: καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον παρὰ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ εὐχαριστῶν αὐτῷ καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν Σαμαρίτης
verses.transliteration: kai epesen epi prosōpon para tous podas autou eucharistōn autō kai autos ēn Samaritēs
verses.literal: He fell facedown at Jesus’ feet in thanksgiving to Him and he was a Samaritan
verses.literalPt: E caiu aos seus pés, com o rosto em terra, dando-lhe graças; e este era samaritano.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Οὐχὶ οἱ δέκα ἐκαθαρίσθησαν οἱ δὲ ἐννέα ποῦ
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Iēsous eipen Ouchi hoi deka ekatharisthēsan hoi de ennea pou
verses.literal: Were not all ten cleansed - Jesus asked Where then are . . . the other nine
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo Jesus, disse: Não foram dez os limpos? E onde estão os nove?

verses.original: οὐχ εὑρέθησαν ὑποστρέψαντες δοῦναι δόξαν τῷ Θεῷ εἰ μὴ ὁ ἀλλογενὴς οὗτος
verses.transliteration: ouch heurethēsan hypostrepsantes dounai doxan tō Theō ei mē ho allogenēs houtos
verses.literal: Was no one found . . . except . . . this foreigner to return and give glory to God
verses.literalPt: Não houve quem voltasse para dar glória a Deus senão este estrangeiro?

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀναστὰς πορεύου ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autō Anastas poreuou hē pistis sou sesōken se
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to him Rise and go your faith has made you well . . .
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe: Levanta-te, e vai; a tua fé te salvou.

verses.original: Ἐπερωτηθεὶς δὲ ὑπὸ τῶν Φαρισαίων πότε ἔρχεται ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπεν Οὐκ ἔρχεται ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ μετὰ παρατηρήσεως
verses.transliteration: Eperōtētheis de hypo tōn Pharisaiōn pote erchetai hē basileia tou Theou apekrithē autois kai eipen Ouk erchetai hē basileia tou Theou meta paratērēseōs
verses.literal: When asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . The kingdom of God will not come with observable signs
verses.literalPt: E, interrogado pelos fariseus sobre quando havia de vir o reino de Deus, respondeu-lhes, e disse: O reino de Deus não vem com aparência exterior.

verses.original: οὐδὲ ἐροῦσιν Ἰδοὺ ὧδε ἤ Ἐκεῖ ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐντὸς ὑμῶν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: oude erousin Idou hōde ē Ekei idou gar hē basileia tou Theou entos hymōn estin
verses.literal: Nor will people say Look here it is or There it is For you see the kingdom of God is in your midst
verses.literalPt: Nem dirão: Ei-lo aqui, ou: Ei-lo ali; porque eis que o reino de Deus está entre vós.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητάς Ἐλεύσονται ἡμέραι ὅτε ἐπιθυμήσετε μίαν τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἰδεῖν καὶ οὐκ ὄψεσθε
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros tous mathētas Eleusontai hēmerai hote epithymēsete mian tōn hēmerōn tou Huiou tou anthrōpou idein kai ouk opsesthe
verses.literal: Then He said to the disciples The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man but you will not see it
verses.literalPt: E disse aos discípulos: Dias virão em que desejareis ver um dos dias do Filho do homem, e não o vereis.

verses.original: καὶ ἐροῦσιν ὑμῖν Ἰδοὺ ἐκεῖ ἤ Ἰδοὺ ὧδε μὴ ἀπέλθητε μηδὲ διώξητε
verses.transliteration: kai erousin hymin Idou ekei ē Idou hōde mē apelthēte mēde diōxēte
verses.literal: People will tell you Look there He is or Look here He is Do not go out or chase after them
verses.literalPt: E dir-vos-ão: Ei-lo aqui, ou: Ei-lo ali. Não vades, nem os sigais;

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἡ ἀστραπὴ ἀστράπτουσα ἐκ τῆς ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν εἰς τὴν ὑπ’ οὐρανὸν λάμπει οὕτως ἔσται ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar hē astrapē astraptousa ek tēs hypo ton ouranon eis tēn hyp’ ouranon lampei houtōs estai ho Huios tou anthrōpou en tē hēmera autou
verses.literal: For just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other - so will be the Son of Man in His day
verses.literalPt: Porque, como o relâmpago ilumina desde uma extremidade inferior do céu até à outra extremidade, assim será também o Filho do homem no seu dia.

verses.original: πρῶτον δὲ δεῖ αὐτὸν πολλὰ παθεῖν καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης
verses.transliteration: prōton de dei auton polla pathein kai apodokimasthēnai apo tēs geneas tautēs
verses.literal: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation
verses.literalPt: Mas primeiro convém que ele padeça muito, e seja reprovado por esta geração.

verses.original: Καὶ καθὼς ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Νῶε οὕτως ἔσται καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: Kai kathōs egeneto en tais hēmerais Nōe houtōs estai kai en tais hēmerais tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: Just as it was in the days of Noah so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man
verses.literalPt: E, como aconteceu nos dias de Noé, assim será também nos dias do Filho do homem.

verses.original: ἤσθιον ἔπινον ἐγάμουν ἐγαμίζοντο ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας εἰσῆλθεν Νῶε εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ κατακλυσμὸς καὶ ἀπώλεσεν πάντας
verses.transliteration: ēsthion epinon egamoun egamizonto achri hēs hēmeras eisēlthen Nōe eis tēn kibōton kai ēlthen ho kataklysmos kai apōlesen pantas
verses.literal: People were eating and drinking marrying and being given in marriage up to the day Noah entered . . . the ark Then the flood came and destroyed them all
verses.literalPt: Comiam, bebiam, casavam, e davam-se em casamento, até ao dia em que Noé entrou na arca, e veio o dilúvio, e os consumiu a todos.

verses.original: Ὁμοίως καθὼς ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Λώτ ἤσθιον ἔπινον ἠγόραζον ἐπώλουν ἐφύτευον ᾠκοδόμουν
verses.transliteration: Homoiōs kathōs egeneto en tais hēmerais Lōt ēsthion epinon ēgorazon epōloun ephyteuon ōkodomoun
verses.literal: It was the same . . . in the days of Lot People were eating and drinking buying and selling planting and building
verses.literalPt: Como também da mesma maneira aconteceu nos dias de Ló: Comiam, bebiam, compravam, vendiam, plantavam e edificavam;

verses.original: ᾗ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ ἐξῆλθεν Λὼτ ἀπὸ Σοδόμων ἔβρεξεν πῦρ καὶ θεῖον ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἀπώλεσεν πάντας
verses.transliteration: hē de hēmera exēlthen Lōt apo Sodomōn ebrexen pyr kai theion ap’ ouranou kai apōlesen pantas
verses.literal: But on the day Lot left . . . Sodom fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all
verses.literalPt: Mas no dia em que Ló saiu de Sodoma choveu do céu fogo e enxofre, e os consumiu a todos.

verses.original: Κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ ἔσται ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀποκαλύπτεται
verses.transliteration: Kata ta auta estai hē hēmera ho Huios tou anthrōpou apokalyptetai
verses.literal: It will be just like that . . . . . . on the day the Son of Man is revealed
verses.literalPt: Assim será no dia em que o Filho do homem se há de manifestar.

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὃς ἔσται ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ μὴ καταβάτω ἆραι αὐτά καὶ ὁ ἐν ἀγρῷ ὁμοίως μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω
verses.transliteration: en ekeinē tē hēmera hos estai epi tou dōmatos kai ta skeuē autou en tē oikia mē katabatō arai auta kai ho en agrō homoiōs mē epistrepsatō eis ta opisō
verses.literal: On that day let no one . . . on the housetop come down to retrieve . . . his possessions . . . . . . . . . Likewise let no one . . . in the field return for anything he has left behind
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, quem estiver no telhado, tendo as suas alfaias em casa, não desça a tomá-las; e, da mesma sorte, o que estiver no campo não volte para trás.

verses.original: μνημονεύετε τῆς γυναικὸς Λώτ
verses.transliteration: mnēmoneuete tēs gynaikos Lōt
verses.literal: Remember Lot’s wife
verses.literalPt: Lembrai-vos da mulher de Ló.

verses.original: ὃς ἐὰν ζητήσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ περιποιήσασθαι ἀπολέσει αὐτήν ὃς δ’ ἂν ἀπολέσῃ ζωογονήσει αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: hos ean zētēsē tēn psychēn autou peripoiēsasthai apolesei autēn hos d’ an apolesē zōogonēsei autēn
verses.literal: Whoever . . . tries to save his life will lose it but whoever . . . loses his life will preserve it
verses.literalPt: Qualquer que procurar salvar a sua vida, perdê-la-á, e qualquer que a perder, salvá-la-á.

verses.original: λέγω ὑμῖν ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ ἔσονται δύο ἐπὶ κλίνης μιᾶς ὁ εἷς παραλημφθήσεται καὶ ὁ ἕτερος ἀφεθήσεται
verses.transliteration: legō hymin tautē tē nykti esontai dyo epi klinēs mias ho heis paralēmphthēsetai kai ho heteros aphethēsetai
verses.literal: I tell you on that night two people will be in one bed one will be taken and the other left
verses.literalPt: Digo-vos que naquela noite estarão dois numa cama; um será tomado, e outro será deixado.

verses.original: ἔσονται δύο ἀλήθουσαι ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό ἡ μία παραλημφθήσεται ἡ δὲ ἑτέρα ἀφεθήσεται
verses.transliteration: esontai dyo alēthousai epi to auto hē mia paralēmphthēsetai hē de hetera aphethēsetai
verses.literal: Two women will be grinding grain together one will be taken and the other left
verses.literalPt: Duas estarão juntas, moendo; uma será tomada, e outra será deixada.
Dois estarão no campo; um será tomado, o outro será deixado.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθέντες λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Ποῦ Κύριε Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὅπου τὸ σῶμα ἐκεῖ καὶ οἱ ἀετοὶ ἐπισυναχθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Kai apokrithentes legousin autō Pou Kyrie Ho de eipen autois Hopou to sōma ekei kai hoi aetoi episynachthēsontai
verses.literal: Where Lord they asked . . . . . . - Jesus answered . . . Wherever there is a carcass there the vultures will gather
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo, disseram-lhe: Onde, Senhor? E ele lhes disse: Onde estiver o corpo, aí se ajuntarão as águias.
